limitations: Environment conditions are reported only when present in the supplied measurement metadata
Reference pins use different Lean versions; consult recorded measurement versions
The summary does not infer measurement provenance or discarded-run history from timing values
Structured profile thresholds and instrumentation must be read from individual recorded profile commands
All-tracked reverse closure is potential invalidation; named workload closures model requested build targets, not measured rebuild execution
Generated paths and bounded spans separated from ambiguous markers and unmarked source; unmarked does not mean handwritten
Targeted tails are separate from size-stratified rate estimates.
Generated source classes are marker-based; unmarked is not proven handwritten. Timing classes cover whole files; mixed generated spans are line-counted separately, not timed independently.

Full estimates are deterministic model outputs, not validated runtime bounds; named checkpoint/full/Bridge closures overlap and must not be summed. Quartiles are selected from all tracked area modules, not a random target-specific sample.
Reference build-attempt timings include dependency preparation; only complete per-project module sums are compared.
Recommendations use two dependency cost pools plus the eight slowest observed sample modules, not a global exhaustive ranking; no saving or proof-preservation implementation is claimed.

limitations: Targeted tails are separate from size-stratified rate estimates.
Generated source classes are marker-based; unmarked is not proven handwritten. Timing classes cover whole files; mixed generated spans are line-counted separately, not timed independently.

Full estimates are deterministic model outputs, not validated runtime bounds; named checkpoint/full/Bridge closures overlap and must not be summed. Quartiles are selected from all tracked area modules, not a random target-specific sample.
Reference build-attempt timings include dependency preparation; only complete per-project module sums are compared.
Recommendations use two dependency cost pools plus the eight slowest observed sample modules, not a global exhaustive ranking; no saving or proof-preservation implementation is claimed.
